The reference contains all 46 operation chapters. Field tables are generated
from the distribution; examples and task descriptions are maintained alongside
the tested sources. The [documentation index](https://github.com/edigonzales/gretl-runtime/blob/main/docs/README.md)
also links to runtime configuration, static includes and the editor.
